remarks: For rent is this Charming and low maintenance! Open and sunny and recently rebuilt with the best of everything! Perfectly designed floor plan flexible and versatile with master bedroom/walk in closet on the main level. The attention to detail abounds with many custom upgrades created by the builder 4 years ago including Hardwood floors, crown molding, vaulted ceiling, abundant windows, cozy front porch, detached garage, and ample storage space. The open concept kitchen features new countertops, stainless steel appliances and custom island for breakfast bar. This New England style cape includes 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths or 3 bedrooms and office/family room. The second floor allows for privacy with 2 bedrooms and full bath. The front porch is great for morning coffee or entertaining into the evening. The East Norwalk train station, Calf Pasture beach, and SoNo are just 1/2 mile away.
